data.one_liner: Performance overlay package for Flutter apps that works on web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a custom performance overlay widget that can be wrapped around a Flutter app. It displays performance data via customizable charts, alignments, and themes.
use_when: You need to display performance metrics on Flutter web
You want a customizable performance overlay instead of the default Flutter one
avoid_when: You are looking for state management or dependency injection
You require advanced logging or crash reporting features
strengths: Highly customizable via parameters like alignment, scale, sampleSize, and colors
weaknesses: Limited feature set beyond the performance overlay widget
Documentation points to external GitHub main README for limitations and reading charts
